purpose.summary: This is a NIST CCVS85 (COBOL Compiler Validation System) test program that validates Format 2 of the SEARCH statement (SEARCH ALL / binary search) against a three-dimensional table with ascending and descending keys. It writes pass/fail results to a print file (report.log).

notable_features: Three-dimensional OCCURS table with multiple ASCENDING/DESCENDING KEY clauses and multiple INDEXED BY indices
SEARCH ALL (Format 2) validation — the primary test subject
NIST CCVS85 standard test harness boilerplate (CCVS-H-*, CCVS-E-*, TEST-RESULTS, PASS-COUNTER, ERROR-COUNTER)
REDEFINES used extensively for numeric display formatting
COMPUTATIONAL (binary) fields for identifiers and counters
No EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS, no COPY statements, no external CALLs
